subject: Rename z{malloc,calloc,realloc,free} into valkey_{malloc,calloc,realloc,free} (#1169)
reason: The change only renames the z{malloc,calloc,realloc,free} linker symbols to valkey_{malloc,calloc,realloc,free} via #define in src/zmalloc.h and updates matching prototypes in the hdr_histogram shim, to avoid symbol collisions with zlib under static linking. All call sites are unchanged and the allocator's behavior is identical; this is a build/link-level refactor with no runtime behavior change, and any error in it would surface as a compile or link failure rather than anything a runtime scenario could detect.
